notes: difficulty is the classical p-value (proportion correct in the norming sample); range 0.1-1.0, HIGHER = EASIER. irt.b is derived as b = -ln(p/(1-p)), with p capped to [0.02, 0.98] for derivation.
IRT model: 3PL (a = discrimination, b = difficulty on the logit scale, c = pseudo-guessing). Theta is on the N(0,1) logit scale.
Scale mapping: percentileRank = Phi(theta)*100 (0-100); standardScore = 100 + 15*z (baseline mean 100, SD 15). Both interpretations of the spec are emitted.
ICAR items are ICAR-format originals (4 domains x 4 items). They are NOT verbatim ICAR items, which are copyrighted (ICAR Project).
WLEIS items are construct-parallel originals (4 subscales x 4 items). The original WLEIS is copyrighted (Wong & Law, 2002); replace with licensed items for commercial use.
All templates and answer keys are server-side only. Clients receive fully resolved session instances (see antiCheat).
Spatial items use asset codes (e.g. L-UP) resolved server-side to hosted SVG assets; the key scheme is renderer-agnostic.

norming.estimator: EAP (default): deterministic midpoint quadrature over [-6, 6], step 0.025. MLE (bisection on the 3PL score function) available with EAP fallback.

antiCheat.templateDelivery: Templates and answer keys are stored server-side only; clients receive a fully resolved session instance.
antiCheat.perSessionSeed: crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] generated at session start; one draw per randomized variable per item per session.
antiCheat.parameterRandomization: Every variable listed under item.parameterization.randomizedVariables is re-sampled per session; no parameter set is reused across sessions for the same candidate.
antiCheat.distractorUniqueness: After sampling, options are deduplicated and checked against the correct answer; collision triggers a re-sample (max 5 attempts, then a deterministic fallback pool).
antiCheat.optionShuffle: Option order MAY be shuffled server-side; correctIndex is recomputed and stored on the session record. Never shipped in the template.
antiCheat.answerValidation: Answer keys are never exposed to the client; scoring runs exclusively server-side.
antiCheat.itemVersioning: Every resolved instance carries itemId + variantHash (SHA-256 of the resolved prompt/options) for post-hoc audit.
